author: _WhaleZ_
body:
Firstly I would like to start of on the note of how sorry am I.  Firstly I would honestly say I was not hacking despite this is what I was banned for this is what happened...

I was playing avicus today for the first time and was having a great time loving the server, soon I had after come round and with them all using my internet I had severe lag which im sure must have been seen.  When I would pvp I would have as low as 3-5 fps and I would constantly freeze while freezing I would click my normal speed and after a couple of seconds I would get the killed this worked well when there was a lot of players as this seemed to cause the lag.  I can definitely understand why it may have been seen as hacks especially kb reducer but the fact the lag stopped me from moving much did this.  The fact it was only a kb reducer shows it wasn't complete anti kb and could be due to lag.  Next the aimbot I was banned for was also understandable I had a huge lag advantage in pvp and was killing many.I understand and again am very truly sorry for continuously playing when I had this severe lag and can understand how it can be seen as hacks, I can reassure you for definite this will never ever happen again and I will take huge precaution of staying true to this one last time I am very sorry and hope I can be unbanned
